title: Secondary Education, B.S. — Biology Teaching Option (College of Education)
notes: Biology Teaching Option, University Park (of five content-area options: Biology, Chemistry, Earth and Space Science, English, Mathematics -- Biology chosen since it's the only one with a fully detailed 8-semester plan in the fetched source). Extended scied_catalog.json/spled_catalog.json/ci_catalog.json with SCIED 411W/412, SPLED 403B, CI 295/495C/495E. Real data artifact handled: CI 495C and CI 495E both cite 'LLED 412W/MTHED 412W/SCIED 412/SSED 412W' as corequisites/prereqs -- these are the content-methods courses for the English/Math/Science/Social-Studies teaching options respectively; only SCIED 412 (Science) applies to this Biology option, so the other three were treated as a shared bulletin template artifact across all Secondary Education options and not modeled, same judgment-call precedent as CI 495D's 'CI 495B' case in Elementary Education. Most SPLED/CI/SCIED courses also cite '2nd/4th/5th/7th-semester standing' prereqs the schema doesn't model directly, same limitation as ABSM/TURF's semester-standing courses. 'BIOL 300-400 selection' (x2), 'BIOL elective', 'Evolution/elective', 'Biochem selection', and generic GEN ED/GE-elective pools are modeled generically, same convention as CMPSC's own open pools. Post-rescrape real gap found: CHEM 110 has a real, literal 'MATH 22' prereq (not MATH 140/141), which chains through MATH 21 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 3, none of which were scheduled -- and BIOL 240W needs CHEM 110 specifically (no alternative). Added the full MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 -> MATH 22 chain across Semesters 1-4; this major's generous 20cr/semester cap (vs. the more typical 15-17) left plenty of room to absorb the extra 12 credits without any swapping. CHEM 110/111/112/113/BIOL 240W all clear automatically once the chain resolves.
